releases.title: 版本更新
content: 新增：脚注引用支持悬停预览对应的脚注定义，未找到定义时给出提示
新增：公式、Mermaid 源码编辑换用带语法高亮的深色代码编辑器，Mermaid 支持自动换行开关
优化：公式、Mermaid、HTML、脚注、提示块的编辑面板改为原位展开，单击即可编辑，点击外部自动保存
新增：输入 ==文字== 即转为高亮样式，保存时还原为 == 语法
修复：保存时硬换行按原写法（行尾两空格或反斜杠）还原，不再被统一改写
修复：链接标题、表格分隔行保存时不再丢失或被改写
优化：选中公式、图片等整体节点时不再弹出 AI 动作条
修复：源码模式滚动同步定位不准的问题
优化：补充 H5/H6 标题样式，编辑器与 AI 消息中显示层级更清晰
优化：更新应用、安装包及各平台图标资源
contentEn: Footnote references show a hover preview of their definition, with a notice when no definition exists.
Formula and Mermaid source editing now uses a dark syntax-highlighted code editor; Mermaid supports a line-wrapping toggle.
Editing panels for formulas, Mermaid, HTML, footnotes, and callouts expand inline: click to edit and click outside to save.
Typing ==text== becomes highlighted and is saved back as == syntax.
Hard line breaks are saved with their original form (two trailing spaces or a backslash) instead of being normalized.
Link titles and table delimiter rows are no longer lost or rewritten on save.
Selecting whole nodes such as formulas or images no longer shows the AI action bar.
Fixed inaccurate scroll synchronization in source mode.
Added H5 and H6 heading styles for clearer hierarchy in the editor and AI messages.
Updated the app, installer, and platform icon assets.

linux.requirements: 主流 64 位 Linux 发行版
